_comment: Alt texts of the RU v3 photos (data, not code; edit and rebuild: python3 scripts/tenerife_site_build/build_v3.py). 'images' = default alt per photo file; 'slots' = override for one slot, key '<page>/<Fxx>', value {file, alt} — the build fails if 'file' is no longer the photo of that slot. Review list: python3 scripts/tenerife_site_build/alts.py export <out.md>; apply an edited list: alts.py import <in.md>.
